name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Holds back a click that would kill you by a few ticks (as few as possible) and fires it when it is safe. Press and release, every mode.

buffer-ticks.name: Max Ticks
buffer-ticks.description: Largest delay the buffer may add, in 240 TPS ticks (1 tick = 4.17 ms). Each gamemode can be capped lower below. The toggle key cycles 2 / 4 / 8 / 16 / off.

randomize.name: Randomize (ticks)
randomize.description: 0 = always the smallest safe delay. Above 0 = any safe delay up to this many ticks above the smallest one, picked at random.

buffer-releases.name: Releases
buffer-releases.description: Also holds back early releases in wave and robot (and ship, if Ship is on).

buffer-ship.name: Ship
buffer-ship.description: Lets the buffer work in ship mode. Off by default: ship predictions are less reliable.

show-feedback.name: Timing Popup
show-feedback.description: Shows in game how early each held-back click was.

death-check.name: Death Check
death-check.description: When you die within a second of the buffer changing an input, says so in game and in the window, so you know if it helped or hurt.

modes-title.name: Per-mode limits
modes-title.description: The most each gamemode may be delayed, on top of Max Ticks (the lower of the two wins).

max-cube.name: Cube
max-cube.description: Largest delay in cube mode, in ticks.

max-ship.name: Ship
max-ship.description: Largest delay in ship mode, in ticks.

max-ball.name: Ball
max-ball.description: Largest delay in ball mode, in ticks.

max-ufo.name: UFO
max-ufo.description: Largest delay in UFO mode, in ticks.

max-wave.name: Wave
max-wave.description: Largest delay in wave mode, in ticks.

max-robot.name: Robot
max-robot.description: Largest delay in robot mode, in ticks.

max-spider.name: Spider
max-spider.description: Largest delay in spider mode, in ticks.

max-swing.name: Swing
max-swing.description: Largest delay in swing mode, in ticks.

open-window.name: Open Window On Launch
open-window.description: Opens the window when the game starts. Off: it only opens with the toggle key.

window-size.name: Window Size (%)
window-size.description: On top of the automatic sizing (1x on 1080p, 1.33x on 1440p).

checks-title.name: Checks
checks-title.description: How the hidden ghost judges a delay. All on is best; each can be switched off on its own.

finer-timing.name: Finer Timing
finer-timing.description: Delays in quarter ticks instead of whole ticks, fired in the middle of a physics step, so a click moves only as much as it has to (not in dual).

best-fix.name: Best Fix
best-fix.description: Compares the safe delays further ahead and takes the one that keeps you alive longest, not just the first one that works.

confidence-check.name: Only When Sure
confidence-check.description: Before helping, checks that a quarter tick later would also be safe, so it never fixes a click on a knife edge. If not, your input goes through untouched.

moving-objects.name: See Moving Objects
moving-objects.description: The ghost moves blocks and spikes that are moving (move triggers) along with it instead of treating them as still.

hold-fix.name: Hold Fix (wave / ship)
hold-fix.description: When holding on a little too long would kill you and letting go right then is safe, lets go for you (within the mode's limit). Ship only when Ship is on.

through-pads.name: Use Pads And Portals
through-pads.description: The ghost uses yellow / pink / red pads, speed portals and gravity portals itself, so the buffer still helps near them. Pads start working once you've hit that pad type once.

fresh-ghost.name: Fresh Ghost
fresh-ghost.description: Resets the hidden ghost's held button before every check, so each check starts the same way.

stop-at-portals.name: Stop At Orbs / Mode Portals
stop-at-portals.description: Things the ghost can't use itself (orbs, mode / size / dual / mirror / teleport portals) end a check as unknown, so your input goes through untouched.

smart-safety.name: Smart Safety
smart-safety.description: Cube-like modes: looks a bit further ahead and prefers delays where the jump fully clears or lands, falling back to the old rule if none does.

steady-timing.name: Steady Timing (Click Between Frames)
steady-timing.description: Runs the ghost at the full step size and counts the delay in full steps, so Click Between Frames' split steps don't throw it off.
